# ProxyGosha

> Zero-cost, single-file Telegram WEB Proxy running on Cloudflare Workers (v1.2.2). Unblock Telegram (Desktop, Android, and iOS) across all 6 Cloudflare HTTPS ports with no VPS, no maintenance, and 100% free serverless infrastructure.

## Overview
ProxyGosha transforms a free Cloudflare Worker (`worker.js`) into a high-performance Telegram WEB proxy server. It listens on all six Cloudflare HTTPS ports (443, 2053, 2083, 2087, 2096, 8443) over HTTPS and WebSockets, serves a deceptive e-commerce decoy landing page to unauthenticated web crawlers and active scanners, and tunnels MTProto traffic directly to official Telegram Data Centers (DCs 1–5) using raw TCP sockets (`cloudflare:sockets`).

## Key Features
- **Zero Cost & Serverless**: Runs completely on Cloudflare's free tier (100,000 requests/day).
- **Single File (`worker.js`)**: Pure JavaScript ES Module without external dependencies or npm build steps.
- **6-Port DPI Bypass**: Concurrently supports all 6 Cloudflare HTTPS ports (`443`, `2053`, `2083`, `2087`, `2096`, `8443`) with isolated, deterministically derived per-port secrets.
- **Fast Mode (Zero-CPU Downloads)**: DC-to-client payloads match the client cipher keystream, allowing heavy download data (media/files) to pass through untouched with near-zero CPU consumption.
- **Upstream Batching**: Coalesces small upstream MTProto frames before encrypting and writing to DC sockets, slashing WebCrypto CPU execution overhead.
- **Live Telemetry & DC Probe**: Built-in admin status dashboard (`/<ADMIN_KEY>/status`) with real-time metrics (active sessions, bandwidth, isolate uptime) and on-demand Telegram DC reachability and latency testing (`?probe=1`).
- **Privacy-Preserving & Stealth**: No user IP addresses, tokens, or secrets are ever logged or persisted. Unauthorized requests hit an authentic multi-page e-commerce decoy storefront (LUXVEIL).
- **One-Variable Admin Setup**: Setting `ADMIN_KEY` automatically generates and manages the admin panel, bilingual setup guides (English and Persian), and cryptographic port secrets.

## Technical Specifications
- **Version**: 1.2.2
- **Runtime**: Cloudflare Workers (V8 JavaScript isolate).
- **Transport**: HTTPS & WSS (Ports: 443, 2053, 2083, 2087, 2096, 8443).
- **Carrier Modes**: `websocket-lanes` (default, multi-stream multiplexing) or `websocket` (single stream).
- **Socket Driver**: `cloudflare:sockets` TCP outbound socket with automatic socket cleanup and failover.
- **Protocol**: Telegram Desktop "WEB" proxy carrier (Bridge protocol) + MTProto Obfuscated2.
- **Client Compatibility**: Telegram Desktop, Android, and iOS (where WEB proxy is supported).
- **Middle-End & Ad Tags**: Sponsored channel ad tags (ME route) are incompatible with Cloudflare Workers due to dynamic NAPT source port translation in Cloudflare's egress network; ProxyGosha uses direct-DC routing.

## Configuration & Environment Variables
Configured in Cloudflare Dashboard -> Workers & Pages -> Settings -> Variables and Secrets:
- `ADMIN_KEY`: **Required.** Administrative password (>= 16 characters). Controls access to the panel and derives all port secrets.
- `SECRET`: **Optional.** Fixed 32-character hexadecimal secret. Set if you want to change `ADMIN_KEY` later without invalidating previously shared links.
- `EXTRA_HOSTS`: **Optional.** Comma-separated list of secondary custom domains bound to this Worker.
- `DECOY_URL`: **Optional.** Reverse-proxy URL to mirror an external website instead of the built-in decoy store.
- `CARRIER`: **Optional.** Default is `websocket-lanes`. Set to `websocket` if needed.
- `HOSTNAME`: **Optional.** Comma-separated domain allowlist (default: `*`).
- `DEBUG`: **Optional.** Set to `"true"` to enable diagnostic logs.

## Admin & Diagnostics Endpoints
- **Management Panel**: `https://<YOUR_CUSTOM_DOMAIN>/<ADMIN_KEY>` (Displays ready-to-click Telegram links and manual connection parameters for all 6 ports).
- **Live Status & DC Probe**: `https://<YOUR_CUSTOM_DOMAIN>/<ADMIN_KEY>/status` (Real-time bandwidth, active sessions, isolate uptime, and `?probe=1` DC latency tester).

## Domain Requirements
The default `*.workers.dev` domain is blocked by state-level firewalls in countries like Iran, China, and Russia. A **custom domain** bound in Cloudflare (Settings -> Domains & Routes) is required for stable connectivity.
